sentences.text: The petitioner on the ground that he is the sole owner of the property, which is the subject matter of the writ petition, which has been acquired by the State for the purpose of the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board ('KIADB' for short) has filed the instant writ petition seeking a direction to KIADB to pass a consent award and pay him the compensation instead of the general award.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the Special Land Acquisition Officer, KIADB (respondent no.3)
submits that the document received by them in respect of the property concerned reveals that there is a dispute as to ownership, and hence, a general award has been passed.

He further submits that if the petitioner were to produce the necessary documents and show that there is no dispute in respect of the property concerned, in that event, they have no objection to pass a consent award.
The petitioner is agreeable for the same.
(iii) The writ petition stands disposed of accordingly.

Sd/-
(M.I.ARUN) JUDGE hkh.
